title: Katamari Damacy (USA)
notes: STARTER profile. Addresses come from the raw NTSC-U codes on GameHacking.org (Freeze Time / Resume Time, Time Modifier, Player 1 Ball Size / Speed / Appearance Size, Level Select). Those codes write a value without saying its format, so time and size are each shown as BOTH an f32 and a raw u32: compare with the on-screen timer and ball size, then tell me which reading is right and I will drop the other. Player 2 equivalents: ball size 0x0098C4DC, speed 0x0098C4E8, appearance size 0x0098C4F0. Also published but not shown: a 22-record level-completion table starting at 0x0055FF9C (record stride unconfirmed) and a collectibles flag table at 0x0055F664.
